notes.title: Motor Tournament Major Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188594/6f58410358c6b364cdf242c151149063bea3029d.png[/img]

[h1]Motor Tournament – Major Update![/h1]

It’s been a little over six months since the last update, and we’re excited to finally share what we’ve been working on. A lot has changed under the hood—literally—and we’ve got three big reasons for the wait.

[h2]Framerate-Independent Physics[/h2]
[i]Vehicle Physics v0.4[/i]
We’ve completely reworked the vehicle physics system to run independently from the frame rate. This means smoother, more consistent handling across different machines, and most importantly—fairer multiplayer races.
This is a big step forward in making the gameplay feel solid and synchronized for everyone.
[b]Note:[/b] The system is still in development and does not yet represent the final quality or feature set.

[h2]Multiplayer Overhaul[/h2]
[i]Vehicle Sync v0.2[/i]
Multiplayer has gotten a major upgrade! After lots of testing and iteration, we’ve introduced a more stable and feature-rich system. Here are some of the key improvements: [list]

Spectator mode added

Automatic join/leave handling

Upgraded core gameplay loop

New respawn system implemented
[/list]

These changes aim to make multiplayer matches more seamless, reliable, and fun.

[h2]New Map in Development[/h2]
The first official map for Motor Tournament is now underway!
We’ve also been building out terrain tools, testing new workflows, and creating custom textures to support it. Currently, the new map is the only one available, but it’s designed specifically to complement the current game mode—and there's much more to come.

Thank you all for your patience and continued support! We’re still early in development, and community feedback is incredibly valuable to us. Please keep sharing your thoughts and suggestions—we’re listening and learning as we go.

notes.title: Motor Tournament Update 0.8.1
notes.content:
[b]Motor Tournament - Major Update 0.8.1[/b]

[b]Added: [/b]
	- Added UI for basic graphics and sound settings
	- Added Basic Car customisations / system for customisatons in the future
	- Savegame System implemented, now graphics settings, car settings and all additional user releated information is going to save
	- New Garage UI for vehicle customisations
	- Implemented respawn system, this is still WIP but now you can respawn if you got stuck
	
[b]Updated:[/b]
	- Rewritten multiplayer spawning algorhytm, It now spawns players with their own settings and customisations
	- Updated the way some UI elements are stored, cleaned up some old code
	- Updated the lobby interface, you can now select the specific map you want to start
	- Minor update to AI behavior
	- Minor update to tire behavior on asphalt
	- Niagara FX should work again(It was broken for some reason)
	- Major Update to vehicle synchorisation
        - Updated the default track


[b]Fixed:[/b]
	- The Quit To Menu button should now work properly
